caption:
Busy all day. Still the bottleneck? ⏳

When every question, approval and small task waits for you, the business slows down the moment you step away.

Sort each task into one of four groups: retain (only you), delegate (someone else can do it), write it down (make the steps clear) or automate (a tool can repeat it). Start with one task this week.

The delivery-questions example in the carousel is hypothetical.
